members.name: status
members.doc: What the AI is doing. Leave unset and the spark self-plays idle → thinking → generating → done (demos only).

members.name: size
members.doc: Size in px, or any CSS length such as "1em" to match surrounding text. Defaults: 24 (32 for the avatar tile, 16 for the mark inside the pill).

members.name: label
members.doc: Pill text, overriding the built-in label for the current status, e.g. "Reading 12 files".

members.name: speed
members.doc: Multiplies every loop and spin speed.

members.name: twinkle
members.doc: A slow breathing twinkle while idle. Off = a fully still idle mark.

members.name: paused
members.doc: Freezes the animation in place; resuming continues from the same phase.

members.name: announce
members.doc: Announce status changes through a polite live region. Off for decorative copies so only one spark speaks (role="img" instead).
